cover.title: Why Is a Plumber So Expensive?

lines.text: You pay $120. Your plumber gets about $30.
lines.say: You pay a hundred twenty. Your plumber gets thirty.

lines.text: A master plumber bills about $120/hr (Angi). The typical plumber's wage: $30.67/hr (BLS, 2025).
lines.say: Cost guides put a master plumber at about a hundred twenty dollars an hour. The typical plumber's wage was about thirty-one dollars in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: First, benefits. Wages are about 70% of what workers cost: $30.67 / 0.70 = about $44.
lines.say: First, benefits. Wages are only about seventy percent of what a worker costs. So a thirty-one dollar wage really costs about forty-four.

lines.text: Then unbilled time: driving, estimates, parts runs. Say 6 of 8 hours get billed: about $58 per billed hour.
lines.say: Then unbilled time: driving, estimates, parts runs. Say six of eight hours get billed. That's about fifty-eight dollars per billed hour.

lines.text: The other $62 covers the truck, tools, insurance, licenses, office and profit. Parts are usually extra.
lines.say: The other sixty-two dollars covers the truck, tools, insurance, licenses, the office, and some profit. Parts are usually extra.

lines.text: And the skill isn't quick: most plumbers train 4 to 5 years as apprentices.
lines.say: And the skill isn't quick. Most plumbers train four to five years as apprentices.

lines.text: Wages have climbed too: from $26.52 in 2019 to $30.67 in 2025, before inflation.
lines.say: Wages have climbed too, from about twenty-six fifty an hour in twenty nineteen to over thirty dollars in twenty twenty-five, before inflation.

lines.text: So that $120 isn't a paycheck. It's a whole business on wheels.
lines.say: So that hundred and twenty isn't a paycheck. It's a whole business on wheels.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: You pay $120 an hour. Your plumber gets about $30. Why?
post.ig:
You pay about $120 an hour. Your plumber gets about $30.
The median wage for plumbers was $30.67/hr in May 2025 (BLS). Master plumbers bill about $120/hr on average (Angi).
Benefits push the true labor cost to about $44/hr, and unbilled drive time makes it about $58 per billed hour.
The rest covers the truck, tools, insurance, licenses, office and profit. Parts are usually extra.
Sources: BLS, Angi.
News and education, not financial advice.
